puzzles.name: Twisted Corridor Rotation
puzzles.description: Rotate the central corridor to align paths. Four positions change room connections.
steps: Shoot eye switch on wall with Fairy Bow
puzzles.reward: Access to all 4 Poe Sister rooms

puzzles.name: Poe Sisters Puzzle
puzzles.description: Defeat 4 Poe Sisters by shooting the real one among illusions. Joelle, Beth, Amy, Margaret.
steps: Watch Poe spin - real one has distinct color
Collect flames to light torches in main hall
puzzles.reward: Main Hall torches lit, Boss Key
hints: Each sister has unique color: Red, Blue, Green, Purple

puzzles.name: Fairy Bow Chest
puzzles.description: Shoot eye switch through bars to lower chest platform containing Fairy Bow.
steps: Shoot eye switch on far wall through bars
Shoot eye switch inside room to exit

puzzles.name: Falling Ceiling Room
puzzles.description: Hit crystal switch to stop ceiling, then hookshot to ceiling to avoid crush.

puzzles.name: Wallmaster Shadow Puzzle
puzzles.description: Avoid Wallmasters by watching shadows on floor. Use Lens of Truth to see them early.
steps: Watch for circular shadows on floor
Lens of Truth reveals them on ceiling
Hookshot ceiling to pull them down early

puzzles.name: Boss Key Acquisition
puzzles.description: Push block onto switch in rotating room to spawn Boss Key chest.
steps: Rotate corridor to align block room
hints: Block room accessible from rotated corridor

phases.name: Painting Game
phases.mechanic: Phantom Ganon rides horse through paintings, player must identify real one
phases.puzzle: Watch for painting with no reflection/distortion, shoot with Bow
phases.vulnerability: Real painting shows Ganon clearly, fakes are distorted

phases.name: Tennis Match
phases.mechanic: Phantom Ganon floats, shoots energy balls - reflect with sword
phases.puzzle: Perfect parry energy balls back at Ganon
phases.vulnerability: Ball slows before impact - time parry

phases.name: Sword Duel
phases.mechanic: Close range sword fight, Ganon teleports
